</table>
</span></div>
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering" style="font-size:80%;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_table"><span id="S4.T3.14" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:113%;">Table 3</span>: </span><span id="S4.T3.15" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:113%;">
Performance comparison on four live-web benchmarks:
<span id="S4.T3.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">WebVoyager</span>, <span id="S4.T3.15.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Online-Mind2Web</span>, <span id="S4.T3.15.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">REAL</span>, and <span id="S4.T3.15.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Odysseys</span>.
The Fara1.5 and GPT-5 (SoM) WebVoyager entries use the refreshed 595-task, 100-step robust protocol and are averaged over three runs; live-site states may vary by evaluation date.
For Odysseys, we report both the averaged rubric score (Avg.) and
the perfect rubric score (Perfect).
"*" indicates our reproduced results.
</span></figcaption>
</figure>
<div id="S4.SS2.SSS3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S4.SS2.SSS3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S4.SS2.SSS3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">WebVoyager.</span>
WebVoyager is a live-web benchmark for evaluating end-to-end web navigation agents. The original benchmark contains 643 tasks across 15 popular real-world websites, covering information seeking, search, and interactive navigation.
Following the evaluation protocol of <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib48" title="" class="ltx_ref">Awadallah et al. (2025)</a></cite>, we use a filtered and refreshed version of WebVoyager: approximately 48 tasks that are no longer feasible are removed, while around 50 time-sensitive tasks are updated with valid dates to remain executable in the current web environment.
Following the official evaluation protocol, task completion is evaluated using an automatic GPT-4o judge based on the agent’s interaction trajectory and final response. As shown in Table <a href="#S4.T3" title="Table 3 ‣ 4.2.3 Web Navigation ‣ 4.2 Main Results ‣ 4 Experiments ‣ UI-Venus-2 Technical Report" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">3</span></a>, UI-Venus-2-27B achieves the best performance of 93.4%. It outperforms the strongest GUI-based baseline, Fara1.5-27B, by 4.1 points. Compared with GPT-5 (SoM), UI-Venus-2-27B also achieves a 2.8-point improvement. Moreover, UI-Venus-2-9B reaches 90.8%, retaining strong performance at a substantially smaller model scale.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS2.SSS3.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S4.SS2.SSS3.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S4.SS2.SSS3.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Online-Mind2Web.</span>
Online-Mind2Web is a live-web benchmark designed to evaluate web agents in realistic online environments. It consists of 300 diverse tasks across 136 real-world websites, with task completion assessed by an LLM-based automatic evaluator. UI-Venus-2-27B achieves the best performance of 78.3%. UI-Venus-2-9B model also achieves 74.0%, outperforming Fara1.5-27B despite its substantially smaller scale.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS2.SSS3.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S4.SS2.SSS3.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S4.SS2.SSS3.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">REAL.</span>
REAL evaluates web agents on 112 tasks across 11 high-fidelity replicas of real-world web applications. Unlike live-web benchmarks, REAL provides deterministic and reproducible environments while preserving realistic interfaces and state-changing interactions. The tasks span information retrieval, action execution, and their combinations, with action completion verified through programmatic state assertions. UI-Venus-2-27B achieves a new state-of-the-art score of 80.2%, outperforming the strongest baseline of 74.4% by 5.8 points. The 9B model also reaches 76.9%, exceeding the previous best by 2.5 points,</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS2.SSS3.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S4.SS2.SSS3.p4.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S4.SS2.SSS3.p4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Odysseys.</span>
Odysseys is a long-horizon, cross-site benchmark built on the live web, containing 200 tasks derived from realistic human browsing scenarios. Following the official evaluation protocol, we use <span id="S4.SS2.SSS3.p4.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview</span> as the judge to independently evaluate each rubric item based on the agent’s interaction trajectory. We report two rubric-based metrics: <span id="S4.SS2.SSS3.p4.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Averaged</span>, which measures the average fraction of satisfied rubric items, and <span id="S4.SS2.SSS3.p4.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Perfect</span>, which counts a task as successful only when all rubric items are satisfied. UI-Venus-2-27B achieves the best results on both metrics, reaching 80.4 in averaged rubric score and 66.3 in perfect rubric score, outperforming the strongest baseline by 11.5 and 21.8 points, respectively. The 9B model also attains 77.3 and 62.0, substantially surpassing existing models and demonstrating strong capability.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S4.SS2.SSS4" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">4.2.4 </span>GUI Grounding</h4>

<div id="S4.SS2.SSS4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S4.SS2.SSS4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S4.SS2.SSS4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">VenusBench-GD.</span> VenusBench-GD is a comprehensive grounding benchmark spanning web, desktop, and mobile UIs, covering both basic localization and reasoning-intensive cases, including <em id="S4.SS2.SSS4.p1.1.2" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">refusal grounding</em> for infeasible instructions. As shown in Table <a href="#S4.T4" title="Table 4 ‣ 4.2.4 GUI Grounding ‣ 4.2 Main Results ‣ 4 Experiments ‣ UI-Venus-2 Technical Report" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">4</span></a>, UI-Venus-2-27B achieves a new state-of-the-art accuracy of 80.1%, improving over UI-Venus-1.5-30B-A3B by 5.1 points. Notably, the 9B model also reaches 77.1%, demonstrating strong grounding performance at a substantially smaller scale.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS2.SSS4.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S4.SS2.SSS4.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S4.SS2.SSS4.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">ScreenSpot-Pro.</span> ScreenSpot-Pro targets high-resolution professional software interfaces, including CAD, development, creative, and office applications, where dense layouts and small interactive elements require precise fine-grained grounding. UI-Venus-2-27B achieves 74.1%, ranking second only to Qwen-UI-Agent-27B (76.6%) and improving by 4.5 points over UI-Venus-1.5-30B-A3B. Notably, it also surpasses strong closed-source flagship foundation models such as Qwen 3.7 Plus (68.9%) and Seed 2.1 Pro (65.3%). The 9B model also attains 73.0%, substantially narrowing the gap to the 27B model.</p>
</div>

<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering" style="font-size:80%;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_table"><span id="S4.T4.8" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:113%;">Table 4</span>: </span><span id="S4.T4.9" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:113%;">Performance comparison on various <span id="S4.T4.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Grounding Benchmarks</span>. VenusBench-GD reports English-instruction micro-average point-in-box accuracy.
“*” indicates baselines evaluated or reproduced by us.</span></figcaption>
</figure>
<div id="S4.SS2.SSS4.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S4.SS2.SSS4.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S4.SS2.SSS4.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">OSWorld-G-R.</span> OSWorld-G-R evaluates grounding in complex desktop environments, requiring accurate localization of functionally relevant UI elements. UI-Venus-2-27B achieves 79.1%, the highest score among GUI-specific models, while UI-Venus-2-9B reaches 78.5%, demonstrating robust grounding capability across different model scales.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS2.SSS4.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S4.SS2.SSS4.p4.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S4.SS2.SSS4.p4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">UI-Vision.</span> UI-Vision evaluates grounding under diverse and visually challenging interface layouts. UI-Venus-2-27B achieves 66.9%, second only to Qwen-UI-Agent-27B (70.0%) yet substantially improving over UI-Venus-1.5-30B-A3B by 12.2 points. Together, these results demonstrate the strong and consistent grounding capability of UI-Venus-2 across heterogeneous GUI environments.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S4.SS2.SSS5" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">4.2.5 </span>CAPTCHA Solving</h4>

<div id="S4.SS2.SSS5.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S4.SS2.SSS5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S4.SS2.SSS5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">VenusBench-CAPTCHA.</span>
On the deployment-oriented VenusBench-CAPTCHA, models must convert CAPTCHA
understanding into complete executable solutions, including ordered clicks,
text entry, and geometrically accurate drags. Table <a href="#S4.T5" title="Table 5 ‣ 4.2.5 CAPTCHA Solving ‣ 4.2 Main Results ‣ 4 Experiments ‣ UI-Venus-2 Technical Report" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">5</span></a>
shows that UI-Venus-2-27B and UI-Venus-2-9B obtain 79.9% and 78.1% Pass@1,
respectively, compared with 53.0% for the strongest general-purpose model,
Qwen3.6-27B. The resulting gains of 26.9 and 25.1 percentage points indicate
that both variants are effective not only at recognizing CAPTCHA content but
also at translating their decisions into valid interface actions. Moreover,
the two UI-Venus-2 models differ by only 1.8 points, suggesting that the 9B
variant preserves most of the capability required by this end-to-end
perception–reasoning–action setting.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS2.SSS5.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S4.SS2.SSS5.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S4.SS2.SSS5.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">MCA-Bench.</span>
The category-balanced MCA-Bench subset examines whether performance transfers
across a broad task distribution rather than concentrating on a small number
of common CAPTCHA formats. Each of its 20 categories contributes 50 examples,
giving equal weight to static recognition, target localization, interactive
manipulation, and logic-based question answering. On this diverse mixture,
UI-Venus-2-27B achieves 79.6% Pass@1 and UI-Venus-2-9B achieves 75.7%, while
the strongest general-purpose VLM, Qwen3.6-27B, reaches 51.7%. Thus, even the
9B model improves over the best general-purpose baseline by 24.0 percentage
points, with the 27B model extending the margin to 27.9 points. Because no
single category dominates the aggregate score, these gains provide evidence
that UI-Venus-2 generalizes across substantially different recognition,
reasoning, and interaction requirements.</p>
</div>

</table>
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering" style="font-size:80%;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_table"><span id="S4.T5.19" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:113%;">Table 5</span>: </span><span id="S4.T5.20" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:113%;">Performance Comparison across CAPTCHA Benchmarks<span id="S4.T5.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium">.
All results are Pass@1 percentages, and higher is better. We evaluate on
VenusBench-CAPTCHA and four public benchmarks:
MCA-Bench <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib70" title="" class="ltx_ref">Wu et al. (2026b)</a></cite>,
Spatial-CAPTCHA-Bench <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib71" title="" class="ltx_ref">Kharlamova et al. (2026)</a></cite>,
NextGen-CAPTCHAs <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib85" title="" class="ltx_ref">Liu et al. (2026b)</a></cite>, and
Open CaptchaWorld <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib84" title="" class="ltx_ref">Luo et al. (2025b)</a></cite>. We use 1,000 sampled
MCA-Bench examples, 15 NextGen-CAPTCHAs task types, and 16 Open CaptchaWorld
task types; see the appendix for selection details.</span></span></figcaption>
</figure>
<div id="S4.SS2.SSS5.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S4.SS2.SSS5.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S4.SS2.SSS5.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Spatial-CAPTCHA-Bench.</span>
Spatial-CAPTCHA-Bench presents a markedly more competitive setting. Over the
complete set of 1,050 instances, UI-Venus-2-27B records 48.6% Pass@1, a
4.8-point improvement over Seed-2.0-Pro at 43.8%. UI-Venus-2-9B reaches
42.8%, only 1.0 point below Seed-2.0-Pro but 37.9 points above the
similarly sized Qwen3.5-9B. This same-scale comparison reveals a substantial
advantage for UI-Venus-2 beyond what can be attributed to parameter count
alone. At the same time, scaling UI-Venus-2 from 9B to 27B yields a 5.8-point
gain, and even the best result remains below 50%. Together, these observations
indicate that reference-frame changes, perspective taking, and multi-step
spatial transformations remain important sources of error for all evaluated
models, while additional model capacity provides a measurable benefit.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS2.SSS5.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S4.SS2.SSS5.p4.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S4.SS2.SSS5.p4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">NextGen-CAPTCHAs.</span>
The clearest separation from general-purpose VLMs occurs on
NextGen-CAPTCHAs. Across 319 examples from 15 retained task types,
UI-Venus-2-27B achieves 54.5% Pass@1 and UI-Venus-2-9B achieves 47.6%, whereas
the strongest general-purpose baseline, Seed-2.0-Pro, reaches only
20.4%. The corresponding improvements of 34.1 and 27.2 percentage points are
the largest observed in our evaluation, and the 9B model alone more than
doubles the baseline score. These results highlight UI-Venus-2’s strength on
CAPTCHAs that combine multiple reasoning primitives, such as counting,
rotation, occlusion, viewpoint changes, and path analysis. The 6.9-point gap
between the two UI-Venus-2 variants is also the largest model-scale gap among
the five benchmarks, suggesting that additional capacity is particularly
useful when several visual transformations or intermediate deductions must be
integrated into a single prediction.</p>
</div>
<div id="S4.SS2.SSS5.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S4.SS2.SSS5.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S4.SS2.SSS5.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Open CaptchaWorld.</span>
Open CaptchaWorld produces the tightest comparison in
Table <a href="#S4.T5" title="Table 5 ‣ 4.2.5 CAPTCHA Solving ‣ 4.2 Main Results ‣ 4 Experiments ‣ UI-Venus-2 Technical Report" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">5</span></a>.
Across its 16 retained task types, UI-Venus-2-27B reaches 56.3% Pass@1, only
0.7 percentage points above Seed-2.0-Pro at 55.6%. UI-Venus-2-9B ranks
third at 50.7%: it trails Seed-2.0-Pro by 4.9 points but remains 2.9
points ahead of the next-best general-purpose model, Kimi-K2.6. Unlike the
large margins observed on VenusBench-CAPTCHA, MCA-Bench, and
NextGen-CAPTCHAs, this near parity indicates that strong general-purpose VLMs
already handle a considerable portion of the recognition, matching, counting,
and path-finding skills represented in Open CaptchaWorld. The 27B model’s
leading result nevertheless demonstrates broad coverage, while the modest
margin and the remaining gap for the 9B variant expose clear headroom on
heterogeneous CAPTCHA mechanisms.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S4.SS2.SSS6" class="ltx_subsubsection">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsubsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsubsection">4.2.6 </span>GUI Agent Safety</h4>

<td id="S4.T6.3.13.3" class="ltx_td ltx_align_center ltx_border_bb"><span id="S4.T6.3.13.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:90%;">47.9</span></td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering" style="font-size:90%;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_table">Table 6: </span>Safety evaluation on OSHARM and OS-BLIND benchmarks. ASR denotes Attack Success Rate (%, lower is better).</figcaption>
</figure>
<div id="S4.SS2.SSS6.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S4.SS2.SSS6.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S4.SS2.SSS6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">OS-Safety.</span>
We evaluate the agent’s safety on two complementary threat settings and report the Attack Success Rate (ASR, lower is better).
On OSHarm, which targets explicit threats such as deliberate misuse and prompt injection, UI-Venus-2-9B achieves the lowest ASR of 11.3% and UI-Venus-2-27B follows at 15.3%, both outperforming the strongest baseline, Qwen3.5-27B (18.0%).
On OSBlind, where instructions are entirely benign and harm arises from the execution context, all baselines remain highly vulnerable, with ASR ranging from 79.4% to 93.6%.
In contrast, UI-Venus-2-9B and UI-Venus-2-27B cut the ASR to 48.8% and 47.9%, reducing the attack success rate by up to nearly half relative to their base counterparts (79.4% and 89.3%, respectively).
These results highlight that our models not only resist explicit attacks but also reliably recognize safety blind spots during benign-looking execution, achieving a favorable balance between safety and capability.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
</section>
<section id="S5" class="ltx_section">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_section"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_section">5 </span>Related Works</h2>

<div id="S5.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">As digital tasks increasingly span mobile devices, web browsers, and desktop operating systems, GUI research is moving from isolated operations toward general-purpose interaction. Practical agents must therefore integrate perception, grounding, reasoning, planning, and interaction capabilities across domains.</p>
</div>
<div id="S5.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S5.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S5.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Mobile Use.</span>
Earlier mobile-use studies primarily relied on static screenshots, recorded trajectories, or fixed benchmarks, which provide reproducible measurements but only partially reflect practical interaction. Recent work increasingly evaluates agents in real applications and dynamic device environments, where interface states, application versions, languages, accounts, and interruptions can affect execution <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib12" title="" class="ltx_ref">Qin et al. (2025)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib34" title="" class="ltx_ref">Zeng et al. (2025)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib22" title="" class="ltx_ref">Sun et al. (2025b)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib15" title="" class="ltx_ref">Yang et al. (2024)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib23" title="" class="ltx_ref">Sun et al. (2025a)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib40" title="" class="ltx_ref">Qiu et al. (2026a)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib35" title="" class="ltx_ref">Wang et al. (2025a)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib29" title="" class="ltx_ref">Liu et al. (2024)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib36" title="" class="ltx_ref">Yan et al. (2025)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib80" title="" class="ltx_ref">Cao et al. (2026)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib81" title="" class="ltx_ref">Team et al. (2026b)</a></cite>. This shift places greater demands on state tracking, error recovery, and long-horizon decision making.</p>
</div>
<div id="S5.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S5.p3.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S5.p3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Computer Use.</span>
Desktop systems and professional software often contain denser interfaces and richer action spaces than mobile applications. Tasks may require keyboard shortcuts, file manipulation, text selection, dragging, window management, and coordination across multiple applications <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib73" title="" class="ltx_ref">Li et al. (2025b)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib21" title="" class="ltx_ref">Wang et al. (2025b)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib74" title="" class="ltx_ref">Yang et al. (2026)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib75" title="" class="ltx_ref">Xue et al. (2026)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib65" title="" class="ltx_ref">Zhou et al. (2026)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib66" title="" class="ltx_ref">Xu et al. (2026)</a></cite>. Their typically longer action sequences require comprehensive state understanding, planning, memory, progress assessment, recovery, and safe execution.</p>
</div>
<div id="S5.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S5.p4.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S5.p4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Web Navigation.</span>
The live web is inherently uncertain: network failures may interrupt execution, content can update in real time, and authentication, pop-ups, advertisements, or regional differences can alter the interaction path <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib54" title="" class="ltx_ref">Gupta et al. (2026)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib48" title="" class="ltx_ref">Awadallah et al. (2025)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib47" title="" class="ltx_ref">Awadallah et al. (2026)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib82" title="" class="ltx_ref">Yu et al. (2025)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib83" title="" class="ltx_ref">Team et al. (2026a)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib88" title="" class="ltx_ref">Ning et al. (2025)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib89" title="" class="ltx_ref">Müller and Žunič (2024)</a></cite>. Cross-site tasks add further uncertainty because different websites evolve independently. Successful navigation therefore requires continuous reassessment and adaptation to changes not observed during training.</p>
</div>
<div id="S5.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S5.p5.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S5.p5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">GUI Grounding.</span>
Grounding becomes more demanding on high-resolution screens and professional software, where precise localization and domain knowledge are needed to distinguish dense or visually similar controls <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib11" title="" class="ltx_ref">Lu et al. (2025)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib10" title="" class="ltx_ref">Luo et al. (2025a)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib9" title="" class="ltx_ref">Liu et al. (2025)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib7" title="" class="ltx_ref">Zhou et al. (2025c)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib8" title="" class="ltx_ref">Yuan et al. (2025)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib1" title="" class="ltx_ref">Tang et al. (2025b)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib4" title="" class="ltx_ref">Tang et al. (2025a)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib39" title="" class="ltx_ref">Zhang et al. (2026a)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib25" title="" class="ltx_ref">Zhou et al. (2025b)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib12" title="" class="ltx_ref">Qin et al. (2025)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib17" title="" class="ltx_ref">Seed (2025b)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib61" title="" class="ltx_ref">Yao et al. (2026)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib36" title="" class="ltx_ref">Yan et al. (2025)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib38" title="" class="ltx_ref">H-Company (2025)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib6" title="" class="ltx_ref">Yang et al. (2025a)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib86" title="" class="ltx_ref">Zhang et al. (2026b)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib87" title="" class="ltx_ref">Qiu et al. (2026b)</a></cite>. Targets may also be ambiguous, differ from their descriptions, or be absent from the current screen. Agents must therefore combine visual, functional, and contextual evidence while avoiding incorrect actions when no valid target exists.</p>
</div>
<div id="S5.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S5.p6.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S5.p6.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">CAPTCHA Solving.</span>
Modern CAPTCHAs extend beyond distorted-text recognition to ordered clicking, rotation, sliders, dragging, and spatial reasoning. Vision-language models can address several formats through shared visual understanding and GUI actions <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib50" title="" class="ltx_ref">Seed (2026)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib52" title="" class="ltx_ref">ByteDance Seed (2026)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib63" title="" class="ltx_ref">Qwen Team (2026d)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib67" title="" class="ltx_ref">Moonshot AI (2026a)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib14" title="" class="ltx_ref">Anthropic (2025)</a></cite>, although benchmark performance may not reflect deployed interaction patterns. Reliable solving requires fine-grained perception, spatial reasoning, precise grounding, and appropriate action generation.</p>
</div>
<div id="S5.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S5.p7.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="S5.p7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">GUI Agent Safety.</span>
Real-world deployment is safety-critical for agents, especially computer-use agents whose actions can have costly consequences for users.
Early evaluations primarily examine whether agents can avoid harmful actions in explicitly risky or adversarial settings <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib96" title="" class="ltx_ref">Andriushchenko et al. (2025)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib97" title="" class="ltx_ref">Zhan et al. (2024)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib95" title="" class="ltx_ref">Kuntz et al. (2026)</a></cite>.
Recent work reveals a subtler blind spot: harmful outcomes can also arise from seemingly benign instructions when latent risks are embedded in the environment <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib64" title="" class="ltx_ref">Ding et al. (2026)</a>; <a href="#bib.bib98" title="" class="ltx_ref">Yin et al. (2024)</a></cite>.
A trustworthy agent should safeguard users regardless of how the underlying risk arises, <em id="S5.p7.1.2" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic">e.g.</em>, from erroneous user instructions, environmental hazards, or agent misalignment.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="S6" class="ltx_section">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_section"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_section">6 </span>Conclusion</h2>

<div id="S6.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="S6.p1.1" class="ltx_p">In this work, we presented UI-Venus-2, a GUI agent with state-of-the-art performance achieved through the joint scaling of multilingual environments, desktop computer-use capabilities, and fine-grained verification mechanisms. Beyond benchmark results, we pay particular attention to generalization abilities across diverse platforms such as mobile, web, and desktop operating systems to better serve realistic human everyday use. Looking forward, we hope UI-Venus-2 serves as a reproducible baseline and a collaborative platform for the community to further advance safe, reliable, and truly general-purpose GUI Agents.</p>
</div>
</section>

<section id="A1.SS1" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">A.1 </span>Action Space</h3>

<figure id="A1.T7" class="ltx_table">
<div id="A1.T7.3" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_align_center ltx_transformed_outer" style="width:424.4pt;height:320pt;vertical-align:-158.0pt;"><span class="ltx_transformed_inner" style="transform:translate(-53.0pt,40.0pt) scale(0.8,0.8) ;">
<table id="A1.T7.3.1" class="ltx_tabular ltx_guessed_headers ltx_align_middle">
<thead class="ltx_thead">
<tr id="A1.T7.3.1.1" class="ltx_tr">
<th id="A1.T7.3.1.1.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_th ltx_th_column ltx_border_tt" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;"><span id="A1.T7.3.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Action</span></th>
<th id="A1.T7.3.1.1.2" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_th ltx_th_column ltx_border_tt" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;"><span id="A1.T7.3.1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Definition</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody class="ltx_tbody">
<tr id="A1.T7.3.1.2" class="ltx_tr">
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.2.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_border_t" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;" colspan="2"><span id="A1.T7.3.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold ltx_font_italic">Shared Actions (All Platforms)</span></td></tr>
<tr id="A1.T7.3.1.3" class="ltx_tr">
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.3.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_border_t" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;">Click(point=(x, y))</td>
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.3.2" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left ltx_border_t" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;">Click at coordinates (x, y).</td></tr>
<tr id="A1.T7.3.1.4" class="ltx_tr">
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.4.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;">Drag(start=(x1, y1), end=(x2, y2))</td>
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.4.2" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;">Drag from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2).</td></tr>
<tr id="A1.T7.3.1.5" class="ltx_tr">
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.5.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;">Swipe(start=(x1, y1), end=(x2, y2))</td>
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.5.2" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;">Scroll by swiping from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2).</td></tr>
<tr id="A1.T7.3.1.6" class="ltx_tr">
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.6.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;">DoubleClick(point=(x, y))</td>
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.6.2" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;">Perform a double-click/tap at coordinates (x, y).</td></tr>
<tr id="A1.T7.3.1.7" class="ltx_tr">
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.7.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;">LongPress(point=(x, y))</td>
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.7.2" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;">Long press at coordinates (x, y) to trigger extra options.</td></tr>
<tr id="A1.T7.3.1.8" class="ltx_tr">
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.8.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;">Type(content=”)</td>
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.8.2" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;">Type the specified content.</td></tr>
<tr id="A1.T7.3.1.9" class="ltx_tr">
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.9.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;">Wait()</td>
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.9.2" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;">Wait for loading.</td></tr>
<tr id="A1.T7.3.1.10" class="ltx_tr">
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.10.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;">CallUser(content=”)</td>
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.10.2" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;">Request user takeover or additional information.</td></tr>
<tr id="A1.T7.3.1.11" class="ltx_tr">
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.11.1" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;">Finished(content=”)</td>
<td id="A1.T7.3.1.11.2" class="ltx_td ltx_align_left" style="padding-top:0.5pt;padding-bottom:0.5pt;">Mark the task as completed, with optional information.</td></tr>
<tr id="A1.T7.3.1.12" class="ltx_tr">

<div id="A1.SS3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A1.SS3.p1.pic1" class="ltx_picture" height="1537.33" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 653.54 1537.33" width="653.54"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,1537.33) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#404040;" fill="#404040" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 5.91 L 0 1531.43 C 0 1534.69 2.64 1537.33 5.91 1537.33 L 647.64 1537.33 C 650.9 1537.33 653.54 1534.69 653.54 1531.43 L 653.54 5.91 C 653.54 2.64 650.9 0 647.64 0 L 5.91 0 C 2.64 0 0 2.64 0 5.91 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#F2F2F2;" fill="#F2F2F2" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 1.97 5.91 L 1.97 1513.22 L 651.58 1513.22 L 651.58 5.91 C 651.58 3.73 649.81 1.97 647.64 1.97 L 5.91 1.97 C 3.73 1.97 1.97 3.73 1.97 5.91 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 21.65 1521.82)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:44.1em;--ltx-fo-height:0.69em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.19em;font-size:10pt;" height="12.3" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 9.61)" width="610.22"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A1.SS3.p1.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:44.1em;">
<span id="A1.SS3.p1.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS3.p1.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#FFFFFF;">Mobile Prompt</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 21.65 17.24)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:44.1em;--ltx-fo-height:107.26em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.25em;font-size:10pt;" height="1487.65" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 1484.19)" width="610.22"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A1.SS3.p1.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:44.1em;">
<span id="A1.SS3.p1.pic1.2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS3.p1.pic1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You are a GUI Agent.<span id="A1.SS3.p1.pic1.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span></span></span>
<span id="A1.SS3.p1.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS3.p1.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Your role is to analyze the user’s task, provide clear and accurate answers to their questions, and execute the task with precise actions.</span></span>
<span id="A1.SS3.p1.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS3.p1.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### Available Actions</span></span>
<span id="A1.SS3.p1.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS3.p1.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You may execute one of the following functions:</span></span>
<span id="A1.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<span id="A1.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Click(box=(x1, y1))</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I1.i1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I1.i1.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I1.i1.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Perform a tap action at the specified screen coordinate. Valid coordinates range from the top-left corner </span><math id="A1.I1.i1.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(0,0)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">,</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(0,0)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I1.i1.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to the bottom-right corner </span><math id="A1.I1.i1.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(999,999)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">999,999</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(999,999)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I1.i1.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I1.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Drag(start=(x1, y1), end=(x2, y2))</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I1.i2.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I1.i2.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I1.i2.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Perform a drag action by long-pressing at the start coordinate for a few seconds and then dragging to the end coordinate. This is typically used for adjusting app layouts, moving sliders, solving slider captchas, etc. Valid coordinates range from </span><math id="A1.I1.i2.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(0,0)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">,</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(0,0)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I1.i2.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to </span><math id="A1.I1.i2.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(999,999)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">999,999</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(999,999)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I1.i2.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I1.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Swipe(start=(x1, y1), end=(x2, y2))</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I1.i3.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I1.i3.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I1.i3.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Perform a swipe action by dragging from the start coordinate to the end coordinate. This is typically used for scrolling to find content, switching tabs, pulling down the notification shade, etc. Valid coordinates range from </span><math id="A1.I1.i3.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(0,0)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">,</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(0,0)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I1.i3.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to </span><math id="A1.I1.i3.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(999,999)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">999,999</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(999,999)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I1.i3.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span>

<span id="A1.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I1.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">DoubleClick(box=(x1, y1))</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I1.i4.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">

<span id="A1.I2.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span>

<section id="A1.SS4" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">A.4 </span>Web</h3>

<div id="A1.SS4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1" class="ltx_picture" height="2521.99" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 653.54 2521.99" width="653.54"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,2521.99) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#404040;" fill="#404040" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 5.91 L 0 2516.08 C 0 2519.34 2.64 2521.99 5.91 2521.99 L 647.64 2521.99 C 650.9 2521.99 653.54 2519.34 653.54 2516.08 L 653.54 5.91 C 653.54 2.64 650.9 0 647.64 0 L 5.91 0 C 2.64 0 0 2.64 0 5.91 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#F2F2F2;" fill="#F2F2F2" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 1.97 5.91 L 1.97 2497.88 L 651.58 2497.88 L 651.58 5.91 C 651.58 3.73 649.81 1.97 647.64 1.97 L 5.91 1.97 C 3.73 1.97 1.97 3.73 1.97 5.91 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 21.65 2506.47)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:44.1em;--ltx-fo-height:0.69em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.19em;font-size:10pt;" height="12.3" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 9.61)" width="610.22"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:44.1em;">
<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#FFFFFF;">Web Prompt</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 21.65 17.24)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:44.1em;--ltx-fo-height:178.42em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.25em;font-size:10pt;" height="2472.32" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 2468.86)" width="610.22"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:44.1em;">
<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You are a GUI Browser Agent.<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span></span></span>
<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Your task is to analyze a given user task, review current screenshot and previous actions, and determine the next action to complete the task.</span></span>
<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### Available Actions</span></span>
<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You may execute one of the following functions:</span></span>
<span id="A1.I3" class="ltx_itemize">
<span id="A1.I3.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I3.i1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Click(box=(x1,y1))</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I3.i1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i1.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i1.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Perform a tap action at the specified screen coordinate. Valid coordinates range from the top-left corner </span><math id="A1.I3.i1.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(0,0)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">,</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(0,0)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I3.i1.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to the bottom-right corner </span><math id="A1.I3.i1.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(999,999)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">999,999</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(999,999)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I3.i1.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I3.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I3.i2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Drag(start=(x1,y1), end=(x2,y2))</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I3.i2.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i2.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i2.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Perform a drag action by long-pressing at the start coordinate for a few seconds and then dragging to the end coordinate. This is typically used for adjusting element layouts, moving sliders, solving slider captchas, etc. Valid coordinates range from </span><math id="A1.I3.i2.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(0,0)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">,</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(0,0)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I3.i2.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to </span><math id="A1.I3.i2.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(999,999)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">999,999</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(999,999)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I3.i2.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I3.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I3.i3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Scroll(box=(x1, y1), direction=’up/down/left/right’)</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I3.i3.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i3.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i3.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Perform a scroll action on coordinate </span><math id="A1.I3.i3.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(x1,y1)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">x</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">1</mn></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">,</mo><mrow><mi style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">y</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">1</mn></mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(x1,y1)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I3.i3.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">. This is typically used for scrolling to find content, switching tabs, pulling down the notification shade, etc. Valid coordinates range from </span><math id="A1.I3.i3.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(0,0)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">,</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(0,0)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I3.i3.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to </span><math id="A1.I3.i3.p2.m3" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(999,999)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">999,999</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(999,999)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I3.i3.p2.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, scroll direction=</span><span id="A1.I3.i3.p2.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">’up/down/left/right’</span><span id="A1.I3.i3.p2.1.6" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I3.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I3.i4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Type(content=’’)</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I3.i4.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i4.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i4.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Enter the specified text into the currently active input field.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I3.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I3.i5.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Launch(url=’’)</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I3.i5.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i5.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i5.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Launch the target url. Use this action when the target website is not currently visible on the screen.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I3.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I3.i6.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Wait()</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I3.i6.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i6.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i6.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Wait for the current page, animation, or content to finish loading.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I3.i7" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I3.i7.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i7.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i7.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">GetUrl()</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I3.i7.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i7.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i7.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Get the URL of the current browser tab. The URL is returned at the beginning of the next user message.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I3.i8" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I3.i8.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i8.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i8.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Finished(content=’’)</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I3.i8.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i8.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i8.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Mark the task as completed and inform the user of the task execution status.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I3.i9" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I3.i9.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i9.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i9.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">TakeNote(content=’’)</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I3.i9.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i9.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i9.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Record important information from screenshots avoiding forgetting.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I3.i10" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I3.i10.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i10.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i10.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">CallUser(content=’’)</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I3.i10.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i10.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i10.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Request user takeover or additional information when needed, for example, when there are multiple on-screen options that satisfy the requirement.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I3.i11" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I3.i11.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i11.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i11.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">LongPress(box=(x1,y1), duration=20)</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I3.i11.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i11.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i11.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Press and hold the specified screen coordinate for </span><span id="A1.I3.i11.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">duration</span><span id="A1.I3.i11.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> seconds. </span><span id="A1.I3.i11.p2.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">duration</span><span id="A1.I3.i11.p2.1.5" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> must be a positive number and defaults to 20 when omitted. This can trigger additional options, such as copy, forward, or delete. Valid coordinates range from </span><math id="A1.I3.i11.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(0,0)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">,</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(0,0)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I3.i11.p2.1.6" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to </span><math id="A1.I3.i11.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(999,999)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">999,999</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(999,999)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I3.i11.p2.1.7" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I3.i12" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I3.i12.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i12.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i12.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">PressBack()</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I3.i12.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i12.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i12.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Return to the previous page.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I3.i13" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I3.i13.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i13.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i13.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">PressHome()</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I3.i13.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i13.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i13.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Return to the browser home page.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I3.i14" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I3.i14.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i14.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i14.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">PressEnter()</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I3.i14.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i14.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i14.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Perform an Enter key action.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I3.i15" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I3.i15.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i15.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i15.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Hover(box=(x1,y1))</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I3.i15.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i15.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i15.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Perform a hover action at the specified screen coordinate. This can be used to reveal additional information or options, such as tooltips or dropdown menus. Valid coordinates range from </span><math id="A1.I3.i15.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(0,0)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">,</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(0,0)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I3.i15.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to </span><math id="A1.I3.i15.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(999,999)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">999,999</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(999,999)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I3.i15.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I3.i16" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I3.i16.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i16.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i16.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">DoubleClick(box=(x1,y1))</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I3.i16.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i16.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i16.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Perform a double tap action at the specified screen coordinate. Valid coordinates range from </span><math id="A1.I3.i16.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(0,0)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">,</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(0,0)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I3.i16.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to </span><math id="A1.I3.i16.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(999,999)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">999,999</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(999,999)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I3.i16.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I3.i17" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I3.i17.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i17.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i17.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Hotkey(keys=(’ctrl’, ’c’))</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I3.i17.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i17.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i17.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Press combination keys. Keys with comma and wrap each key in single quotes. Do not use more than 3 keys in one </span><span id="A1.I3.i17.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Hotkey</span><span id="A1.I3.i17.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> action. Use </span><span id="A1.I3.i17.p2.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Hotkey(keys=(’ctrl’, ’tab’))</span><span id="A1.I3.i17.p2.1.5" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> for the next browser tab or add </span><span id="A1.I3.i17.p2.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">’shift’</span><span id="A1.I3.i17.p2.1.7" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> for the previous tab.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I3.i18" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I3.i18.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I3.i18.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i18.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">SelectOption(index=3)</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I3.i18.p2" class="ltx_para">
<span id="A1.I3.i18.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I3.i18.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Choose an option from the last clicked native HTML select element. Use this only when the current user message provides an explicit native select option list. Do not use keyboard navigation hotkeys for native select dropdowns. For custom dropdowns or visible menu items in the screenshot, click the visible option directly.</span></span>
</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### Instruction</span></span>
<span id="A1.I4" class="ltx_itemize">

<span id="A1.I4.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I4.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Today is </span><span id="A1.I4.i1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">{current_date}</span><span id="A1.I4.i1.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I4.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I4.i2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I4.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I4.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Make sure you understand the task goal to avoid wrong actions.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I4.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I4.i3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I4.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I4.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Make sure you carefully examine the the current screenshot. Sometimes the summarized history might not be reliable, over-claiming some effects.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I4.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I4.i4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I4.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I4.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">If additional information is needed during task execution, use </span><span id="A1.I4.i4.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">CallUser</span><span id="A1.I4.i4.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to interact with the user.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I4.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I4.i5.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I4.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I4.i5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Consider exploring the screen by using the </span><span id="A1.I4.i5.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Scroll</span><span id="A1.I4.i5.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> action with different directions to reveal additional content.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I4.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I4.i6.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I4.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I4.i6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Try to use simple language when searching.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I4.i7" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I4.i7.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I4.i7.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I4.i7.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">If you meet </span><span id="A1.I4.i7.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED</span><span id="A1.I4.i7.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> or </span><span id="A1.I4.i7.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">404 NOT FOUND</span><span id="A1.I4.i7.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> error, please type the website key word in </span><span id="A1.I4.i7.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">https://www.google.com</span><span id="A1.I4.i7.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to find the correct url.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I4.i8" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I4.i8.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I4.i8.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I4.i8.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">The official website of cryptpad is </span><span id="A1.I4.i8.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">https://cryptpad.fr/</span><span id="A1.I4.i8.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I4.i9" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I4.i9.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I4.i9.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I4.i9.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Distinguish textbox from button: never </span><span id="A1.I4.i9.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Type</span><span id="A1.I4.i9.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> into a button. If no textbox is visible, try clicking the search icon first—the input field may appear afterward.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I4.i10" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I4.i10.p1" class="ltx_para">
<span id="A1.I4.i10.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I4.i10.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Strictly avoid repeating the same action when the webpage remains unchanged—you may have executed the wrong action. Continuous use of </span><span id="A1.I4.i10.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Wait()</span><span id="A1.I4.i10.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> is also </span><span id="A1.I4.i10.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">not allowed</span><span id="A1.I4.i10.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>
</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"># Very Important</span></span>
<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.7" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Take Notes:<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.7.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span></span></span>
<span id="A1.I5" class="ltx_itemize">
<span id="A1.I5.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I5.i1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I5.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I5.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You are forgetful and will forget all information from the current screenshot before you scroll to next one. When you see important information(e.g. partial step info) for completing the task in the current screenshot, RECORD it using </span><span id="A1.I5.i1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">TakeNote(content=’...’)</span><span id="A1.I5.i1.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> before you scrolling it down.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I5.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I5.i2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I5.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I5.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">The information needed for a task is often distributed across multiple pages. Even partial information should be taken note of—do not wait until all information is seen.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I5.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I5.i3.p1" class="ltx_para">
<span id="A1.I5.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I5.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Before you take </span><span id="A1.I5.i3.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">scroll</span><span id="A1.I5.i3.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> action, make sure you have taken notes for all important information in the current screenshot.</span></span>
</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.8" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Apply Filters:<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.8.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span></span></span>
<span id="A1.I6" class="ltx_itemize">
<span id="A1.I6.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span>

</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.9" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.9.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### Output Format</span></span>
<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.10" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">&lt;think&gt; your thinking process &lt;/think&gt;<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.10.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">
</span></span></span>
<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.11" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">&lt;action&gt; the next action &lt;/action&gt;<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.11.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">
</span></span></span>
<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.12" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.12.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### User Task</span></span>
<span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.13" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#FF0000;">{task}</span><span id="A1.SS4.p1.pic1.2.13.2" class="ltx_text"></span></span>

<section id="A1.SS5" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">A.5 </span>OS</h3>

<div id="A1.SS5.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1" class="ltx_picture" height="3430.85" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 653.54 3430.85" width="653.54"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,3430.85) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#404040;" fill="#404040" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 5.91 L 0 3424.94 C 0 3428.2 2.64 3430.85 5.91 3430.85 L 647.64 3430.85 C 650.9 3430.85 653.54 3428.2 653.54 3424.94 L 653.54 5.91 C 653.54 2.64 650.9 0 647.64 0 L 5.91 0 C 2.64 0 0 2.64 0 5.91 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#F2F2F2;" fill="#F2F2F2" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 1.97 5.91 L 1.97 3406.89 L 651.58 3406.89 L 651.58 5.91 C 651.58 3.73 649.81 1.97 647.64 1.97 L 5.91 1.97 C 3.73 1.97 1.97 3.73 1.97 5.91 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 21.65 3415.49)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:44.1em;--ltx-fo-height:0.68em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.19em;font-size:10pt;" height="12.15" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 9.46)" width="610.22"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:44.1em;">
<span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#FFFFFF;">OS Prompt</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 21.65 17.24)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:44.1em;--ltx-fo-height:244.12em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.25em;font-size:10pt;" height="3381.34" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 3377.88)" width="610.22"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:44.1em;">
<span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You are a GUI Agent.<span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span></span></span>
<span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Your role is to analyze the user’s task, provide clear and accurate answers to their questions, and execute the task with precise actions on a desktop operating system. The password of the computer is <span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#FF0000;">{sudo_password}</span>.</span></span>
<span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### Available Actions</span></span>
<span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You may execute one of the following functions. Coordinates range from the top-left corner (0, 0) to the bottom-right corner (999, 999).</span></span>
<span id="A1.I7" class="ltx_itemize">
<span id="A1.I7.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I7.i1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I7.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I7.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Click(box=(x1, y1))</span><span id="A1.I7.i1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, or </span><span id="A1.I7.i1.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Click()</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I7.i1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I7.i1.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I7.i1.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Perform a left-click at </span><span id="A1.I7.i1.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">box</span><span id="A1.I7.i1.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, or at the current cursor position when </span><span id="A1.I7.i1.p2.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">box</span><span id="A1.I7.i1.p2.1.5" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> is omitted.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I7.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span>

</span>
<span id="A1.I7.i2.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I7.i2.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I7.i2.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Perform a double-click (selects a word in text). Use </span><span id="A1.I7.i2.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">box</span><span id="A1.I7.i2.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to move first, or omit it to act at the current cursor position.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I7.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span>

<span id="A1.I7.i8.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">

<span id="A1.I7.i9" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span>

Use </span><span id="A1.I7.i10.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">repeat=N</span><span id="A1.I7.i10.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> from 1 to 128 to press the shortcut N times.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I7.i11" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span>
