</span>
<span id="A1.I7.i11.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I7.i11.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I7.i11.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Press 1 to 128 listed keys in order and keep them held across later actions and model turns until a matching </span><span id="A1.I7.i11.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">KeyUp</span><span id="A1.I7.i11.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>

<span id="A1.I7.i13" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span>

<span id="A1.I7.i15" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I7.i15.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I7.i15.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I7.i15.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Sequence(actions=[Click(box=(x1, y1)), Hotkey(keys=[’ctrl’, ’s’])])</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I7.i15.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I7.i15.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I7.i15.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Execute 2 to 32 actions in order as one open-loop model turn. Nested </span><span id="A1.I7.i15.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Sequence</span><span id="A1.I7.i15.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> is not allowed, and </span><span id="A1.I7.i15.p2.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">CallUser</span><span id="A1.I7.i15.p2.1.5" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> or </span><span id="A1.I7.i15.p2.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Finished</span><span id="A1.I7.i15.p2.1.7" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> may appear only as the final action.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I7.i16" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I7.i16.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I7.i16.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I7.i16.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Wait()</span></span>

<span id="A1.I7.i16.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I7.i16.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I7.i16.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Wait for the current page, animation, or content to finish loading.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I7.i17" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I7.i17.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I7.i17.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I7.i17.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">CallUser(content=’’)</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I7.i17.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I7.i17.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I7.i17.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Request user takeover or report failure when the task cannot be completed or additional information is required.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I7.i18" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I7.i18.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I7.i18.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I7.i18.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Finished(content=’’)</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I7.i18.p2" class="ltx_para">
<span id="A1.I7.i18.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I7.i18.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Mark the task as completed successfully and optionally report details in </span><span id="A1.I7.i18.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">content</span><span id="A1.I7.i18.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>

<span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### Instructions</span></span>
<span id="A1.I8" class="ltx_itemize">
<span id="A1.I8.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I8.i1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I8.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I8.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Make sure you understand the task goal to avoid wrong actions.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I8.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I8.i2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I8.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I8.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Prefer one atomic action per turn. Use </span><span id="A1.I8.i2.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Sequence</span><span id="A1.I8.i2.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> only when every child action is already known and no intermediate screenshot is needed; its children execute open-loop.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I8.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I8.i3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I8.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I8.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">KeyDown</span><span id="A1.I8.i3.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, </span><span id="A1.I8.i3.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">KeyUp</span><span id="A1.I8.i3.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, </span><span id="A1.I8.i3.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">MouseDown</span><span id="A1.I8.i3.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, and </span><span id="A1.I8.i3.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">MouseUp</span><span id="A1.I8.i3.p1.1.8" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> preserve input state across turns. Release held input explicitly when it is no longer needed.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I8.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I8.i4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I8.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I8.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Any </span><span id="A1.I8.i4.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">keys</span><span id="A1.I8.i4.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> list may contain at most 128 non-empty key names; each key name is limited to 1,024 characters.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I8.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I8.i5.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I8.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I8.i5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Swipe</span><span id="A1.I8.i5.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> is the only scrolling action and always scrolls at the current cursor position.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I8.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I8.i6.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I8.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I8.i6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Make sure you carefully examine the current screenshot. Sometimes the summarized history might not be reliable, over-claiming some effects.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I8.i7" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I8.i7.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I8.i7.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I8.i7.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">To submit/search after typing into a field, end the text with a newline — </span><span id="A1.I8.i7.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Type(content=’query\n’)</span><span id="A1.I8.i7.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> — which types the text and presses Enter in one action.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I8.i8" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I8.i8.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I8.i8.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I8.i8.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">To replace the existing content of an input field, use </span><span id="A1.I8.i8.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">TripleClick</span><span id="A1.I8.i8.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to select it, then </span><span id="A1.I8.i8.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Type</span><span id="A1.I8.i8.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> the new content.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I8.i9" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I8.i9.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I8.i9.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I8.i9.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">To open a submenu/dropdown, use </span><span id="A1.I8.i9.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Hover</span><span id="A1.I8.i9.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> over the parent item to reveal it, then </span><span id="A1.I8.i9.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Click</span><span id="A1.I8.i9.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> the desired entry.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I8.i10" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I8.i10.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I8.i10.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I8.i10.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">To use a context menu, </span><span id="A1.I8.i10.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">RightClick</span><span id="A1.I8.i10.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> the target to open it, then </span><span id="A1.I8.i10.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Click</span><span id="A1.I8.i10.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> the desired entry.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I8.i11" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I8.i11.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I8.i11.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I8.i11.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">To hold a modifier during another action, use </span><span id="A1.I8.i11.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">KeyDown</span><span id="A1.I8.i11.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, the target action, and </span><span id="A1.I8.i11.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">KeyUp</span><span id="A1.I8.i11.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">. Put them in one </span><span id="A1.I8.i11.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Sequence</span><span id="A1.I8.i11.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> only when no intermediate screenshot is needed.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I8.i12" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I8.i12.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I8.i12.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I8.i12.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">After launching an app, running a command, downloading, or any slow operation, use </span><span id="A1.I8.i12.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Wait()</span><span id="A1.I8.i12.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to let it finish before continuing.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I8.i13" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I8.i13.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I8.i13.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I8.i13.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">To press a key or shortcut several times, use </span><span id="A1.I8.i13.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">repeat</span><span id="A1.I8.i13.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, e.g. </span><span id="A1.I8.i13.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Hotkey(keys=[’down’], repeat=5)</span><span id="A1.I8.i13.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> or </span><span id="A1.I8.i13.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Hotkey(keys=[’ctrl’, ’z’], repeat=3)</span><span id="A1.I8.i13.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, instead of repeating the action.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I8.i14" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I8.i14.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I8.i14.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I8.i14.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Consider exploring the screen by using the </span><span id="A1.I8.i14.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Swipe</span><span id="A1.I8.i14.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> action to scroll and reveal additional content.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I8.i15" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I8.i15.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I8.i15.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I8.i15.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Use </span><span id="A1.I8.i15.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Hotkey</span><span id="A1.I8.i15.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> for keyboard shortcuts: copy (</span><span id="A1.I8.i15.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">ctrl+c</span><span id="A1.I8.i15.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">), paste (</span><span id="A1.I8.i15.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">ctrl+v</span><span id="A1.I8.i15.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">), save (</span><span id="A1.I8.i15.p1.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">ctrl+s</span><span id="A1.I8.i15.p1.1.9" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">), undo (</span><span id="A1.I8.i15.p1.1.10" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">ctrl+z</span><span id="A1.I8.i15.p1.1.11" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">), find (</span><span id="A1.I8.i15.p1.1.12" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">ctrl+f</span><span id="A1.I8.i15.p1.1.13" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">), etc.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I8.i16" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I8.i16.p1" class="ltx_para">
<span id="A1.I8.i16.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I8.i16.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">If the task cannot be completed or additional information is needed, use </span><span id="A1.I8.i16.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">CallUser</span><span id="A1.I8.i16.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">. Use </span><span id="A1.I8.i16.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Finished</span><span id="A1.I8.i16.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> only after successful completion.</span></span>
</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### Output Format</span></span>
<span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.7" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">&lt;think&gt; your thinking process &lt;/think&gt;<span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">
</span></span></span>
<span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.8" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">&lt;action&gt; the next action &lt;/action&gt;<span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.8.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">
</span></span></span>
<span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.9" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.9.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### User Task</span></span>
<span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.10" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#FF0000;">{user_task}</span><span id="A1.SS5.p1.pic1.2.10.2" class="ltx_text"></span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A1.SS6" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">A.6 </span>CAPTCHA</h3>

<div id="A1.SS6.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent"><span class="ltx_inline-block"><svg id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1" class="ltx_picture" height="2638.07" overflow="visible" version="1.1" viewBox="0 0 653.54 2638.07" width="653.54"><g style="--ltx-stroke-color:#000000;--ltx-fill-color:#000000;" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0.4pt" transform="translate(0,2638.07) matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 0)"><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#404040;" fill="#404040" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 0 5.91 L 0 2632.16 C 0 2635.42 2.64 2638.07 5.91 2638.07 L 647.64 2638.07 C 650.9 2638.07 653.54 2635.42 653.54 2632.16 L 653.54 5.91 C 653.54 2.64 650.9 0 647.64 0 L 5.91 0 C 2.64 0 0 2.64 0 5.91 Z"></path></g><g style="--ltx-fill-color:#F2F2F2;" fill="#F2F2F2" fill-opacity="1.0"><path style="stroke:none" d="M 1.97 5.91 L 1.97 2614.11 L 651.58 2614.11 L 651.58 5.91 C 651.58 3.73 649.81 1.97 647.64 1.97 L 5.91 1.97 C 3.73 1.97 1.97 3.73 1.97 5.91 Z"></path></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 21.65 2622.7)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:44.1em;--ltx-fo-height:0.68em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.19em;font-size:10pt;" height="12.15" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 9.46)" width="610.22"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.1" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:44.1em;">
<span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#FFFFFF;">CAPTCHA Prompt</span></span>
</span></span></span></foreignObject></g><g fill-opacity="1.0" transform="matrix(1.0 0.0 0.0 1.0 21.65 16.85)"><foreignObject style="--ltx-fo-width:44.1em;--ltx-fo-height:186.85em;--ltx-fo-depth:0.22em;font-size:10pt;" height="2588.55" overflow="visible" transform="matrix(1 0 0 -1 0 2585.47)" width="610.22"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_container"><span class="ltx_foreignobject_content">
<span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2" class="ltx_inline-block ltx_minipage ltx_align_bottom" style="width:44.1em;">
<span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You are a GUI Agent.<span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_text"></span></span></span>
<span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.2" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.2.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Your role is to analyze the user’s task, provide clear and accurate answers to
their questions, and execute the task with precise actions.</span></span>
<span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.3" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.3.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### Available Actions</span></span>
<span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.4" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.4.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">You may execute one of the following functions:</span></span>
<span id="A1.I9" class="ltx_itemize">
<span id="A1.I9.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I9.i1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I9.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I9.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Click(box=(x1, y1))</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I9.i1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I9.i1.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I9.i1.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Perform a tap action at the specified screen coordinate. Valid coordinates
range from the top-left corner </span><math id="A1.I9.i1.p2.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(0,0)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">,</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">0</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(0,0)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I9.i1.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to the bottom-right corner
</span><math id="A1.I9.i1.p2.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="(999,999)" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">(</mo><mn style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000">999,999</mn><mo style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;" mathcolor="#000000" stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(999,999)</annotation></semantics></math><span id="A1.I9.i1.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I9.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span>

<span id="A1.I9.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I9.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Drag(start=(x1, y1), end=(x2, y2))</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I9.i2.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I9.i2.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I9.i2.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Perform a drag action by long-pressing at the start coordinate for a few

</span></span>

<span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.5" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.5.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### Instructions</span></span>
<span id="A1.I10" class="ltx_itemize">
<span id="A1.I10.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I10.i1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I10.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I10.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Make sure you understand the task goal to avoid wrong actions.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I10.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I10.i2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I10.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I10.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Make sure you carefully examine the current screenshot. Sometimes the
summarized history might not be reliable, over-claiming some effects.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I10.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I10.i3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I10.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I10.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">If additional information is needed during task execution, use
</span><span id="A1.I10.i3.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">CallUser</span><span id="A1.I10.i3.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to interact with the user.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I10.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I10.i4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I10.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I10.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Consider exploring the screen by using the </span><span id="A1.I10.i4.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Swipe</span><span id="A1.I10.i4.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> action with
different directions to reveal additional content.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I10.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I10.i5.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I10.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I10.i5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">To copy text: first select the exact text you want to copy, which
usually also brings up the text selection bar, then click the </span><span id="A1.I10.i5.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">copy</span><span id="A1.I10.i5.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">
button in bar.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I10.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I10.i6.p1" class="ltx_para">
<span id="A1.I10.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I10.i6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">To paste text into a text box, first long press the text box, then
usually the text selection bar will appear with a </span><span id="A1.I10.i6.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">paste</span><span id="A1.I10.i6.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> button in
it.</span></span>
</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.6" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.6.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### CAPTCHA-Specific Extension</span></span>
<span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.7" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.7.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">When the user’s task is to pass a CAPTCHA, keep the same GUI-agent action
syntax, but follow these additional CAPTCHA rules:</span></span>
<span id="A1.I11" class="ltx_itemize">
<span id="A1.I11.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I11.i1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I11.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I11.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Treat the screenshot as a visual CAPTCHA challenge. First identify the
CAPTCHA type and the instruction shown in the image.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I11.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I11.i2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I11.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I11.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Ignore unrelated browser/app controls, close buttons, refresh buttons,
feedback icons, ads, page chrome, and decorative content unless they are the
explicit CAPTCHA target.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I11.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I11.i3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I11.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I11.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">For CAPTCHA tasks, the effective final action space is
</span><span id="A1.I11.i3.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Click</span><span id="A1.I11.i3.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, </span><span id="A1.I11.i3.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Drag</span><span id="A1.I11.i3.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, </span><span id="A1.I11.i3.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Type</span><span id="A1.I11.i3.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">, and </span><span id="A1.I11.i3.p1.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">LongPress</span><span id="A1.I11.i3.p1.1.9" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">. Use
other GUI actions only if the CAPTCHA explicitly requires them.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I11.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I11.i4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I11.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I11.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">For selection CAPTCHA tasks, use </span><span id="A1.I11.i4.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Click</span><span id="A1.I11.i4.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> on all target(s)
implied by the instruction: one </span><span id="A1.I11.i4.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Click</span><span id="A1.I11.i4.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> for a single target, and
multiple </span><span id="A1.I11.i4.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Click</span><span id="A1.I11.i4.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> actions for multiple targets.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I11.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I11.i5.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I11.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I11.i5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">For input CAPTCHA tasks, focus the required field(s) when needed and
type the complete answer(s).</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I11.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I11.i6.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I11.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I11.i6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">For manipulation CAPTCHA tasks, use </span><span id="A1.I11.i6.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Drag</span><span id="A1.I11.i6.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> to move, align,
rotate, or match the visual element to the required final state.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I11.i7" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I11.i7.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I11.i7.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I11.i7.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">For press-and-hold CAPTCHA tasks, use </span><span id="A1.I11.i7.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">LongPress</span><span id="A1.I11.i7.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> on the
required hold target.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I11.i8" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I11.i8.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I11.i8.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I11.i8.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">When a CAPTCHA requires multiple interactions, combine all required
actions in the same </span><span id="A1.I11.i8.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">&lt;action&gt;</span><span id="A1.I11.i8.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"> tag, separated by commas, in execution
order.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I11.i9" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I11.i9.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I11.i9.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I11.i9.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">For CAPTCHA tasks, output the complete action sequence at once. Do not
output only the first or next action.</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I11.i10" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I11.i10.p1" class="ltx_para">
<span id="A1.I11.i10.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I11.i10.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Do not add a final submit/confirm click unless the CAPTCHA itself
explicitly requires that click as part of the solution.</span></span>
</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.8" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.8.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">CAPTCHA action examples:</span></span>
<span id="A1.I12" class="ltx_itemize">
<span id="A1.I12.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I12.i1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I12.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I12.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Single-target Click:</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I12.i1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I12.i1.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I12.i1.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">&lt;action&gt;Click(box=(416,889))&lt;/action&gt;</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I12.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I12.i2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I12.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I12.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Multi-target Click:</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I12.i2.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I12.i2.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I12.i2.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">&lt;action&gt;Click(box=(311,382)),Click(box=(688,579)),</span><span id="A1.I12.i2.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">
</span><span id="A1.I12.i2.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Click(box=(311,776))&lt;/action&gt;</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I12.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I12.i3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I12.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I12.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Text input:</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I12.i3.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I12.i3.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I12.i3.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">&lt;action&gt;Click(box=(500,889)),Type(content=’6’)&lt;/action&gt;</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I12.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I12.i4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I12.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I12.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Multiple text fields:</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I12.i4.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I12.i4.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I12.i4.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">&lt;action&gt;Click(box=(385,932)),Type(content=’10’),</span><span id="A1.I12.i4.p2.1.2" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">
</span><span id="A1.I12.i4.p2.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Click(box=(514,932)),Type(content=’7’)&lt;/action&gt;</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I12.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I12.i5.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I12.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I12.i5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Drag:</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I12.i5.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I12.i5.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I12.i5.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">&lt;action&gt;Drag(start=(156,682),end=(485,682))&lt;/action&gt;</span></span>
</span></span>
<span id="A1.I12.i6" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<span id="A1.I12.i6.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A1.I12.i6.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I12.i6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">Hold button:</span></span>
</span>
<span id="A1.I12.i6.p2" class="ltx_para">
<span id="A1.I12.i6.p2.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.I12.i6.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">&lt;action&gt;LongPress(box=(501,800))&lt;/action&gt;</span></span>
</span></span>

<span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.9" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.9.1" class="ltx_text" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">### Output Format</span></span>
<span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.10" class="ltx_p"><span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="--ltx-fg-color:#000000;">&lt;think&gt; your thinking process &lt;/think&gt;<span id="A1.SS6.p1.pic1.2.10.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">

<section id="A2" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix B </span>Grounding Synthesized Example</h2>

<div id="A2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Here, we present some images from the synthetic grounding dataset, featuring various operating systems, office software, entertainment websites, and more, as shown in Figure <a href="#A2.F4" title="Figure 4 ‣ Appendix B Grounding Synthesized Example ‣ UI-Venus-2 Technical Report" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">4</span></a>.</p>
</div>
<figure id="A2.F4" class="ltx_figure"><img src="2609.00028v1/gui_syn_lite.png" id="A2.F4.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_centering ltx_img_square" style="aspect-ratio:471/561;" width="471" height="561" alt="Refer to caption">
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure"><span id="A2.F4.3" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">Figure 4</span>: </span><span id="A2.F4.4" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">Examples of synthesized GUI Grounding training data. Our pipeline generates diverse and realistic interface screenshots spanning desktop (macOS, Windows), mobile (iOS), and web platforms, covering both professional software and consumer applications. All interfaces are rendered in a real headless Chromium browser via Playwright, ensuring high-fidelity visual output that closely mirrors authentic user environments.</span></figcaption>
</figure>
</section>
<section id="A3" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix C </span>CAPTCHA Benchmarks and Evaluation Protocols</h2>

<section id="A3.SS1" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">C.1 </span>VenusBench-CAPTCHA</h3>

<section id="A3.SS1.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Motivation.</h5>

<div id="A3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">CAPTCHAs form a practical bottleneck for autonomous GUI agents: a single
failure at a verification gate can block an otherwise successful workflow.
Solving them is therefore more than an isolated recognition or grounding
problem. A model must interpret the on-screen instruction, extract
fine-grained visual evidence, perform the required semantic, spatial, or
geometric reasoning, and translate its decision into precise executable
actions. Even a correct visual interpretation fails operationally if the
model selects the wrong target, violates the requested order, or executes an
inaccurate click, drag, or text-entry action. VenusBench-CAPTCHA is designed to
stress-test this complete perception–reasoning–action pipeline under a
controlled and reproducible protocol.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS1.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Coverage and task design.</h5>

<div id="A3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">VenusBench-CAPTCHA is a compact evaluation set collected from practical
CAPTCHA deployment scenarios. It contains 219 screenshots spanning eight
interaction types: OCR-based text entry, ordered text click, ordered icon
click, image rotation, drag-to-end, slider puzzle, visual reasoning, and
one-click verification. The first seven categories contain 30 examples each,
while one-click verification contains 9. The captured interfaces retain
surrounding mobile or web context and span 70 image-size configurations across
portrait and landscape layouts, rather than following a single visual
template. As illustrated in
Figure <a href="#A3.F5" title="Figure 5 ‣ Diagnostic value. ‣ C.1 VenusBench-CAPTCHA ‣ Appendix C CAPTCHA Benchmarks and Evaluation Protocols ‣ UI-Venus-2 Technical Report" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">5</span></a>, the task taxonomy ranges from
recognition and transcription to semantic target selection, order-sensitive
grounding, visual reasoning, and continuous geometric manipulation. Every task
is mapped to a common executable action language—<span id="A3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Click</span>, a
<span id="A3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Click</span>–<span id="A3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Type</span> pair, or <span id="A3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Drag</span>—under the same
CAPTCHA-specific prompt, allowing heterogeneous mechanisms to be compared
through a consistent agent interface.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS1.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Diagnostic value.</h5>

<div id="A3.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The benchmark supports both overall model comparison and category-level
capability diagnosis. Its categories separately probe text recognition and
entry, fine-grained target grounding, sequence following, spatial
transformation, visual reasoning, and drag-distance estimation. Evaluation is
performed on executable actions rather than answer text alone: the predicted
action type, count, target region, order, entered text, and drag geometry are
checked as applicable. This exposes failures that answer-only or single-point
grounding metrics can hide. The fixed screenshots and deterministic evaluator
enable reproducible comparison between general-purpose multimodal models and
GUI-specialized agents, while the compact size makes the benchmark practical
for routine regression testing. The broad performance spread in
Table <a href="#S4.T5" title="Table 5 ‣ 4.2.5 CAPTCHA Solving ‣ 4.2 Main Results ‣ 4 Experiments ‣ UI-Venus-2 Technical Report" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">5</span></a> further indicates that the benchmark
remains discriminative across the evaluated model families.</p>
</div>
<figure id="A3.F5" class="ltx_figure"><img src="2609.00028v1/venusbench_captcha_overview.png" id="A3.F5.g1" class="ltx_graphics ltx_centering ltx_img_square" style="aspect-ratio:476/409;" width="476" height="409" alt="Refer to caption">
<figcaption class="ltx_caption ltx_centering"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_figure"><span id="A3.F5.4" class="ltx_text" style="font-size:90%;">Figure 5</span>: </span><span id="A3.F5.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold" style="font-size:90%;">Overview of VenusBench-CAPTCHA.<span id="A3.F5.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_medium">
Each panel shows one complete, uncropped representative screenshot. The OCR
label gives the target transcription, numbered boxes indicate the required
click order, and arrows visualize annotated drag trajectories. These
annotations are added for presentation only and are not part of the model
input.</span></span></figcaption>
</figure>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS2" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">C.2 </span>Public-Benchmark Task Coverage</h3>

<div id="A3.SS2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">In addition to VenusBench-CAPTCHA, we evaluate four public CAPTCHA benchmarks.
These are Spatial-CAPTCHA-Bench <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib71" title="" class="ltx_ref">Kharlamova et al. (2026)</a></cite> and
MCA-Bench <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib70" title="" class="ltx_ref">Wu et al. (2026b)</a></cite>, together with
NextGen-CAPTCHAs <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib85" title="" class="ltx_ref">Liu et al. (2026b)</a></cite> and Open
CaptchaWorld <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_cite"><a href="#bib.bib84" title="" class="ltx_ref">Luo et al. (2025b)</a></cite>. We describe below their task
coverage and any benchmark-specific selection decisions used in our
evaluation.</p>
</div>
<section id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Spatial-CAPTCHA-Bench.</h5>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We use the complete benchmark, comprising 1,050 image–text instances and
seven task formulations at easy, medium, and hard difficulty levels. These
tasks cover four spatial abilities: reference-system reasoning, orientation
and perspective taking, mental rotation, and multi-step spatial visualization.
No task type or example is excluded.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">MCA-Bench.</h5>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">MCA-Bench contains a 4,000-example test set with 200 examples in each of 20
task categories. The categories span static visual recognition,
point-and-click localization, interactive manipulation, and textual logic
question answering. Because the original paper does not specify a
finer-grained test-set partition, and evaluating all 200 examples per category
for every model would incur substantial inference cost, we randomly select 50
of the 200 examples in each category instead of evaluating the full set. This
procedure yields a fixed, category-balanced subset of 1,000 examples that is
shared by all evaluated models.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">NextGen-CAPTCHAs.</h5>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We evaluate the following 15 task types:</p>
<blockquote id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2" class="ltx_quote">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2.1" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">Dice_Roll_Path<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">, </span>Color_Counting<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">,
</span>Hole_Counting<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2.1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">, </span>Rotation_Match<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2.1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">,
</span>Backmost_Layer<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2.1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">, </span>Layered_Stack<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2.1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">,
</span>Illusory_Ribbons<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2.1.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">, </span>Multi_Script<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2.1.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">,
</span>Box_Folding<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2.1.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">, </span>3D_Viewpoint<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2.1.1.10" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">,
</span>Shadow_Direction<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2.1.1.11" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">, </span>Subway_Paths<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2.1.1.12" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">,
</span>Occluded_Pattern_Counting<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2.1.1.13" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">, </span>Shadow_Plausible<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2.1.1.14" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">, and
</span>Mirror<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.2.1.1.15" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">.
</span></span></p>
</blockquote>
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.3" class="ltx_p">We exclude <span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Red_Dot</span> and
<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1.3.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Static_Jigsaw</span> because their released annotations contain label
errors that prevent reliable automatic scoring. The remaining ten task types
are dynamic CAPTCHAs and fall outside the scope of the present evaluation.
Consequently, the reported NextGen-CAPTCHAs results cover only the 15 task
types listed above.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Open CaptchaWorld.</h5>

<div id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The fixed evaluation set used in our experiments covers the following 16 task
types:</p>
<blockquote id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2" class="ltx_quote">
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2.1" class="ltx_p ltx_align_left"><span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter" style="font-size:90%;">Bingo<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">, </span>Connect_icon<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">, </span>Coordinates<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2.1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">,
</span>Dart_Count<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2.1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">, </span>Dice_Count<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2.1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">, </span>Geometry_Click<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2.1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">,
</span>Hold_Button<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2.1.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">, </span>Image_Matching<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2.1.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">,
</span>Image_Recognition<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2.1.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">, </span>Object_Match<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2.1.1.10" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">,
</span>Patch_Select<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2.1.1.11" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">, </span>Path_Finder<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2.1.1.12" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">, </span>Select_Animal<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2.1.1.13" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">,
</span>Slide_Puzzle<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2.1.1.14" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">, </span>Unusual_Detection<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2.1.1.15" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif"> and </span>Rotation_Match<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.2.1.1.16" class="ltx_text ltx_font_serif">.
</span></span></p>
</blockquote>
<p id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.3" class="ltx_p">We do not evaluate <span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Click_Order</span>, <span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.3.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Misleading_Click</span>,
<span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.3.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Pick_Area</span>, or <span id="A3.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1.3.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Place_Dot</span> because their released annotations
contain label errors.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS3" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">C.3 </span>Evaluation Protocol</h3>

<section id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Evaluation sets.</h5>

<div id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">VenusBench-CAPTCHA is evaluated on all 219 examples,
Spatial-CAPTCHA-Bench on all 1,050 examples, MCA-Bench on the 1,000-example
category-balanced subset described above, NextGen-CAPTCHAs on 319 examples
from the 15 retained task types, and Open CaptchaWorld on its 16 retained task
types. All evaluation sets are determined before running any
model and then held fixed, so every model is compared on exactly the same
data. Invalid annotations are excluded rather than corrected after observing
model outputs, and no task or example is selected according to model
performance.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Model interface and action parsing.</h5>

<div id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We use a single-turn setting: the model receives one CAPTCHA screenshot with
the task instruction and a CAPTCHA-specific prompt, and is instructed to emit
the complete solution in one response. The supported action language consists
of <span id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Click</span>, <span id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">LongPress</span>, <span id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Click</span>–<span id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Type</span> pairs,
and <span id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Drag</span>; only the action sequence is scored, while reasoning text is
ignored. Models may produce normalized coordinates in <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.m1" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[0,999]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>0,999</mn><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">[0,999]</annotation></semantics></math> or <math id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.m2" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[0,1]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">[0,1]</annotation></semantics></math>,
or absolute pixel coordinates. We map all predicted coordinates back to the
native image resolution before scoring.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">Action-level correctness.</h5>

<div id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Scoring is strict: the predicted action types and counts must exactly match the
reference, and any missing, extra, malformed, or unsupported action makes the
response incorrect. A <span id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Click</span> or <span id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">LongPress</span> is correct only if
it has the required action type and falls inside a distinct annotated bounding
box. Tasks marked as ordered additionally require the annotated action order;
otherwise, predictions are matched one-to-one to the target boxes without an
order constraint. Text-entry tasks require both a click inside the
corresponding input box and an exact answer match after trimming surrounding
whitespace. A drag task requires exactly one <span id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">Drag</span>: its start point
must lie inside the annotated handle box, its signed horizontal displacement
must have the correct direction and satisfy the configured relative-error
tolerance, and its end-point vertical error must be below five pixels. For the
multi-answer <span id="A3.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">bingo</span> task, exactly two clicks must match any annotated
valid pair, irrespective of their order.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
</section>
</article>
</div>
